scenario: a misunderstanding or problem involving taxi & ride services
english_title: Recognising and Responding to a Misunderstanding or Problem Involving Taxi and Ride Services
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: taxi & ride services — a misunderstanding or problem involving taxi & ride services
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to a misunderstanding or problem involving taxi & ride services; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan tells Mr Daniel there are two streets with the same name.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan nói với anh Daniel có hai con phố cùng tên.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Daniel, I think there are two streets with this name.
turns.vietnamese: Daniel này, hình như có hai con phố cùng tên này.

turns.speaker: Mr Daniel
turns.english: Let me check which one you mean.
turns.vietnamese: Để tôi xem chị muốn đến phố nào.
